This '''beach resort''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]].<ref name="The Smuggler's Code" />

Sometime in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] took a brief respite from the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and relaxed at the resort.<ref name="The Smuggler's Code" />
